content.name: Domino piling
content.description:
给定一个 $M \times N$ 的矩形棋盘。你还拥有无限数量的标准多米诺骨牌，每个多米诺骨牌可以覆盖 $2 \times 1$ 的格子。你可以旋转这些多米诺骨牌。请你在如下条件下尽可能多地在棋盘上放置多米诺骨牌：

1. 每个多米诺骨牌完全覆盖两个格子。
2. 任何两个多米诺骨牌不能重叠。
3. 每个多米诺骨牌必须完全放在棋盘内，可以接触棋盘的边缘。

请你求出在这些限制下，可以放置的多米诺骨牌的最大数量。
content.formatI: 输入仅一行，包含两个整数 $M$ 和 $N$，表示棋盘的大小（$1\leq M\leq N\leq16$）。
content.formatO: 输出一个整数，表示最多可以放置多少个多米诺骨牌。

en.name: Domino piling
en.description:
You are given a rectangular board of $ M×N $ squares. Also you are given an unlimited number of standard domino pieces of $ 2×1 $ squares. You are allowed to rotate the pieces. You are asked to place as many dominoes as possible on the board so as to meet the following conditions:

1\. Each domino completely covers two squares.

2\. No two dominoes overlap.

3\. Each domino lies entirely inside the board. It is allowed to touch the edges of the board.

Find the maximum number of dominoes, which can be placed under these restrictions.
en.formatI: In a single line you are given two integers $ M $ and $ N $ — board sizes in squares ( $ 1<=M<=N<=16 $ ).
en.formatO: Output one number — the maximal number of dominoes, which can be placed.
